# Per-fixture benign-delta allowlist for the e2e-fidelity-compare-spdlog gate.
#
# Format: one symbol name per line; lines starting with `#` and
# blank lines are ignored. Each entry pre-empts impactful
# classification — use sparingly and only for symbols where
# operator triage confirmed the diff is structural / toolchain-
# origin and not a converter bug.
#
# spdlog v1.14.1 (close-gaps campaign rollout): 1404/1404 exported
# symbols match. The five entries below are C++ template
# instantiations from spdlog's vendored fmt header-only inclusion
# that exist on one side but not the other — the cmake distro
# toolchain and Bazel's hermetic toolchain make different
# inlining / instantiation decisions at -O3 -DNDEBUG. The
# fidelity-compare prefix pairer (24-char shared mangled prefix)
# can't pair them because each has no counterpart on the other
# side. None of these are exposed in spdlog's public API; they're
# internal fmt template instantiations spdlog re-emits from
# `#include <spdlog/fmt/bundled/...>` at varying inlining depths
# across the two toolchains.
